sourceMigrations: Five unchanged tables use the final V1-V7 schema; member_weather_locations has four columns and weather_notifications stores notices.

member_weather_locations: `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '서버의 마지막 위치 저장시각 (UTC)',
CONSTRAINT `fk_member_weather_location_member` FOREIGN KEY (`member_id`) REFERENCES `members` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
CONSTRAINT `chk_member_weather_location_grid` CHECK (((`grid_x` between 1 and 149) and (`grid_y` between 1 and 253)))
member_weather_notification_settings: CONSTRAINT `fk_weather_notification_settings_member` FOREIGN KEY (`member_id`) REFERENCES `members` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
weather_daily_forecasts: `tmn` double DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'TMN 원본 일 최저기온 (섭씨)',
`tmn_published_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'TMN 발표시각 (KST); 미수집이면 NULL',
`tmn_collected_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'TMN에 반영한 수집시각 (KST); 미수집이면 NULL',
`tmx` double DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'TMX 원본 일 최고기온 (섭씨)',
`tmx_published_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'TMX 발표시각 (KST); 미수집이면 NULL',
`tmx_collected_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'TMX에 반영한 수집시각 (KST); 미수집이면 NULL',
CONSTRAINT `chk_weather_daily_forecasts_grid` CHECK (((`grid_x` between 1 and 149) and (`grid_y` between 1 and 253))),
CONSTRAINT `chk_weather_daily_forecasts_source` CHECK (((`tmn_published_at` is not null) or (`tmx_published_at` is not null))),

CONSTRAINT `chk_weather_daily_forecasts_tmn_metadata` CHECK ((((`tmn_published_at` is null) and (`tmn_collected_at` is null) and (`tmn` is null)) or ((`tmn_published_at` is not null) and (`tmn_collected_at` is not null)))),

CONSTRAINT `chk_weather_daily_forecasts_tmx_metadata` CHECK ((((`tmx_published_at` is null) and (`tmx_collected_at` is null) and (`tmx` is null)) or ((`tmx_published_at` is not null) and (`tmx_collected_at` is not null))))
weather_forecasts: `published_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '8개 요소의 공통 발표시각 (KST)',
`tmp` double DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'TMP 원본 기온 (섭씨)',
`sky` double DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'SKY 원본 하늘상태 코드',
`pty` double DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'PTY 원본 강수형태 코드',
`pop` double DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'POP 원본 수치; 강수확률 의미 추가 확인 필요',
`pcp` double DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'PCP 원본 수치; 비0 값의 mm 대응 미확인',
`sno` double DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'SNO 원본 수치; 비0 값의 cm 대응 미확인',
`reh` double DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'REH 원본 상대습도 (%)',
`wsd` double DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'WSD 원본 풍속 (m/s)',
`collected_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '행에 반영한 수집시각 (KST)',
CONSTRAINT `chk_weather_forecasts_grid` CHECK (((`grid_x` between 1 and 149) and (`grid_y` between 1 and 253))),
weather_notification_devices: `installation_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
`installation_secret_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
`token` varchar(4096) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
`token_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
CONSTRAINT `fk_weather_device_member` FOREIGN KEY (`member_id`) REFERENCES `members` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
CONSTRAINT `chk_weather_device_active` CHECK (((0 = `active`) or ((`permission` = _utf8mb4'GRANTED') and (`token` is not null) and (`token_hash` is not null)))),
weather_notifications: `notification_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT `fk_weather_notification_member` FOREIGN KEY (`member_id`) REFERENCES `members` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
CONSTRAINT `chk_weather_notification_grid` CHECK (((`grid_x` between 1 and 149) and (`grid_y` between 1 and 253))),
